cards.title: Refusals and limits
items: CSV import and removal: owner or admin; 20 imports per hour
Cart recovery checks in order: paused 503, no_brand 400, trial_over 402, cart data 409, then the 3-credit charge: Noor's cap first, then the balance
no_credits, trial_over and agent_cap open the limit modal; the out-of-credits line differs for an owner, a trial and a member
Governance saves and restores: owner only, 403; Majed's auto-run needs a cap and a confirmation
Role flags only change the view; the routes refuse the same writes with 403

cards.title: While the model is paused
items: Model calls are paused since 2026-09-28; the paused check runs before any charge
Cart recovery and Dana's reports: 'Content generation is paused for now. No credits were used.'
Chat prompts from results get the paused reply; nothing is created
CSV import, ad and store sync, and decks use no model and no credits, so they still work
Governance saves and restores normally, but nothing is generated to apply it to; Majed's auto-run waits; an added brand's setup is refused as paused before the cap check

cards.title: What governance changes later
items: Auto-approve starts new items approved only when the brand gate passes and no cross-agent reviewer flagged them; the judge can send auto-failed ones back to the inbox
Reviewer, cross-agent review and em-dash settings apply on generation
Learning off stops saving edits and rejections and stops feeding past decisions to the prompts
Weekly cap limits the weekly plan, routines and Majed's auto-run; agent caps are enforced in the ledger's charge, before the balance
Noor's cap in an added brand also covers its 9-credit setup from its URL: over it, 402 agent_cap and the cap modal
Every save that changes something is kept in the change history (latest 100) and can be restored by the owner
notifyMinutes is stored, but nothing outside this page reads it
